metadata.title: Heard on the Street: Apple Is a Pricey Safe Haven

content.text:
LIVE
10 min ago
Heard on the Street: Apple Is a Pricey Safe Haven
As the only megacap tech company whose future doesn’t hinge on AI, Apple has become a safe haven of sorts.
The question for investors, though, is whether Apple’s safety premium is worth it.
